item.title: 'datapath' Dialect Rationale
item.description: This document outlines the rationale of the datapath dialect, a dialect used for the efficient construction of arithmetic circuits. Introduction to the datapath dialect Intended Usage Example Introduction to the datapath dialect Datapath design refers to the process of lowering arithmetic circuits to gate-level designs. When lowering arithmetic operations such as comb.add and comb.mul to gate-level implementations there are many component-level implementations to choose from. At the core of efficient gate-level implementations are a collection of circuit constructs that are composed to perform an arithmetic operation on bitvectors.
